title: # Star Trek prerelease cheat sheet (DEC-1218)
intro: Sealed grades, 0 to 10, from oracle text. I checked them against MTG Arena Zone's Draft review on 2 November (49 cards re-read, 20 changed) and against Draftsim's ratings on 3 November (18 re-read, 11 changed). Our uncommons sit 0.58 grade above our commons, under the 1.0 target; the two reviews' gaps are 0.51 and 0.23: between two cards half a grade apart, prefer the uncommon. ★ bomb · ✕ removal · ⚡ instant-speed · ◆ fixing · ✚ card advantage · ⚪🔵⚫🔴🟢 colour · 🟡 gold · ◇ colourless.
procedure: 1. **Sort by colour.** A hybrid card counts for either colour; put gold cards aside.
2. **Count per colour:** cards graded 6+, cards graded 4+, and bombs (★). Write them on the deck box.
3. **Pick the two colours with the most 6+ cards.** A ★ counts as two. Add the pair's gold cards.

4. **Check: 22-23 cards graded 4+ and 15+ creatures.** Count the pair's two colours, its gold cards and your colourless cards. Spacecraft are not creatures. If short, look at the next colour or a splash.

5. **Splash up to 3 cards graded 6+ with 3+ sources of their colour, at most 1 of them a basic.** Sources: duals and shock lands that make it, Class-F Shuttlecraft, Xenobotanist. With 4+ non-basic sources, the third colour may also fill step 4, with cards of 3+ mana.
6. **Build 17 lands and 23 spells, with 7-8 two-drops.** Play the ✕ you have, but do not pick colours for it.
7. **Tie between pairs?** Pick more ★, then more ✚, then more ✕, then more two-drops.
removal_lead: ⚫ Black has the most removal (7 cards) and 🔴 red the highest mean grade (6.8). At common and uncommon, ⚪ white has the most (6). 🔵 Blue has 3 and 🟢 green 2.
ranking_commentary: **Unranked: your pool decides.** Archetype names come from Draftsim's archetype guide (22 October). Look for: our picks from card text, including Draftsim's signposts graded under 5.

WU.name: Spacecraft
WU.plan: Station Spacecraft with creatures you do not need on defence; Hemmer loots each time it taps and gives your Spacecraft hexproof on your turn.
WU.look_for: U.S.S. Excelsior, Cutting Edge [6.5], U.S.S. Cerritos, Following Up [6], Enterprise NX-01 [5], Melkotian Adjudicator [5], Shuttle Ace [5], Suurok-Class Science Vessel [4.5], Class-F Shuttlecraft [4.5].

UB.name: Dilemmas
UB.plan: Play cards with modes: each mode you choose triggers Seven of Nine, Melkotian Adjudicator and the other dilemma cards.
UB.look_for: Resistance Is Futile [7], Impossible Choice [6], Gabriel Lorca, Mirror Menace [5.5], Melkotian Adjudicator [5], Consider the Prime Directive [5], Rogue Artificial Intelligence [5], Tal Shiar Operative [4], Obsidian Order Operative [4].

BR.name: Klingon Sacrifice
BR.plan: Attack every turn with Klingon tokens and cheap creatures, and sacrifice the ones that would die anyway to draw or surveil.
BR.look_for: Eject the Warp Core [6], Cha'DIch Investigator [5.5], Automated Warfare System [5], Sarcophagus, Ship of the Dead [4.5], Battle-Scarred Survivalist [4], Boarding Action [4], Test of Identity [4].

RG.name: Landfall
RG.plan: Play a land every turn: each one makes a Worm, a counter or damage, and extra land drops (U.S.S. Voyager, Erica Ortegas) trigger it again.
RG.look_for: Syndicate Liquidators [6], Captain Michael Burnham [5.5], U.S.S. Voyager, Lone Wanderer [5.5], Exploratory Mission [5], Xindi Surveyors [4.5], Saurian Explorer [4.5], Erica Ortegas, Plucky Pilot [4.5].

WG.name: Counters
WG.plan: Put +1/+1 counters on several creatures and attack: Phlox draws for each one that connects, and The Doctor adds a counter to each.
WG.look_for: Cold-Blooded Crew [5.5], Culber and Stamets, Star-Crossed [5.5], Test of Conviction [5], Dr. McCoy, Surly Surgeon [5], Dominion Supervisor [4.5], Federation Field Medic [4.5], Support Mission [4.5], Pure Energy [4].

WB.name: Artifact Creatures
WB.plan: Make Borg artifact creatures and tokens, then pump them together with Locutus and Assault Drone.
WB.look_for: Resistance Is Futile [7], Hive Mind Coprocessor [5.5], Assembly Specialist [5], Conquest Mission [4.5], Assault Drone [4.5], Tenacious Drone [4], Collective Drone [4].

UR.name: Noncreature Spells
UR.plan: Cast removal, Spacecraft and other noncreature spells to make Officers, counters and Gray and Adira copies; Spock finds the next spell.
UR.look_for: Transporter Malfunction [7], Plasma Cascade [6.5], Consider the Prime Directive [5], Academy Instructor [4.5], Cetacean Ops [4.5], Anthropological Mission [4.5], Tal Shiar Analyst [4], Gray and Adira, Forever Joined [4.5].

BG.name: Leaves the Graveyard
BG.plan: Surveil and mill to stock your graveyard, then cast, exile or return cards from it; Vash draws a card the first time each turn one leaves.
BG.look_for: Hologram Stalker [6], Sylvia Tilly, Joy of Discovery [5.5], Photosynthetic Physician [5.5], Dominion Assault Force [5.5], Blastoneuron [5], Stray from History [4.5], Storied Veteran [4], Relentless Drednok [3.5].

WR.name: Power 8
WR.plan: Attack while your creatures total 8 or more power to turn on Kirk, Worf and the other attack triggers; Officer tokens and counters get you there.
WR.look_for: U.S.S. Cerritos, Following Up [6], Hologram Janeway [5.5], Una Chin-Riley, Number One [5], La'An Noonien-Singh, Security [5], Academy Instructor [4.5], Cantankerous Captain [4], Tactical Officer [3.5], Worf, Honor-Bound Warrior [4.5].

UG.name: Strange New Worlds
UG.plan: Play many differently named lands to grow The Traveler and cut the cost of your strange-new-worlds cards; green holds 4 of the 6 coloured common and uncommon fixers, so add a third colour here.
UG.look_for: Species 8472 [6.5], Suus Mahna Practitioner [5], David and Carol Marcus, Creators [5], Cloak and Phaser [5], Xenobotanist [4.5], D'Vana Tendi, Optimistic Ensign [4.5], Astute Terraformer [4], Final Frontier [3.5].
